mechanism: Critique Reinforcement Learning mixed with standard RL to train coder models
evidence_scope: we propose Critique Reinforcement Learning (CRL), where the model is tasked with generating a critique for a given (question, solution) pair.
evidence_role: we introduce CRITIQUE-CODER, which is trained on a hybrid of RL and CRL by substituting 20% of the standard RL data with CRL data.
